description:
Position will design and implement complex reports, import/export Oracle data, manipulate and reformat data as necessary to meet business requirements. Position should be able to write queries and stored procedures, write data to and from Oracle tables, use data modeling tools, and have an understanding of relational databases. Experience using Oracle (insert version here) or later preferred and SQL experience is a must.  


 - EXCELLENT written and verbal Communication skills.
 

 - Must have expert skill analyzing and writing .NET code using C#.  
 - Expert skill using and applying advanced XML, MVC, Web Forms, Entity Framework, MS Enterprise Libraries and WCF - At least 5 years 
 - Intermediate skill analyzing and writing complex SQL statements using multi table joins, exist clauses, etc. is a plus
 - Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2 - At least 5 years 
 - Must have ability to analyze, modify and create advanced SQL statements and queries using T-SQL
 - Microsoft Visual Studio 2012/2013, TFS - At least 5 years 
 - Microsoft office products to create design and technical documentation. 
 - Development Using Agile and SDLC Teams.
 - Developer Unit Test - At least 5 years 
 - Must have Ability to perform comprehensive unit tests, creating test cases, acceptance criteria and scripts to provide secure and accurate code.  
 - Developer Code Review - At least 5 years 
 - Must have Ability to defend code and logic in a formal code review  
 - Experience with Agile Software Development is a plus
 

 


  - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
 - All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply. 
 - Candidates must clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
